description: This file defines API helper functions for courier-related operations within a food delivery frontend. It includes functions to list courier orders, fetch specific order details, and update order statuses such as accept, picked-up, and delivered, aligned with backend OpenAPI endpoints.

methods.name: listCourierOrdersApi({ status_filter = null } = {}, getToken)
methods.description: Lists orders visible to the current courier, optionally filtered by status.

methods.name: getOrderApi(orderId, getToken)
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific order by its ID.

methods.name: courierAcceptAssignmentApi(orderId, { note = null } = {}, getToken)
methods.description: Allows a courier to accept a delivery assignment without changing the order status.

methods.name: courierMarkPickedUpApi(orderId, { note = null } = {}, getToken)
methods.description: Marks an order as picked up, transitioning from READY_FOR_PICKUP to OUT_FOR_DELIVERY.

methods.name: courierMarkDeliveredApi(orderId, { note = null } = {}, getToken)
methods.description: Marks an order as delivered, transitioning from OUT_FOR_DELIVERY to DELIVERED.

ctags.pattern: /^export async function courierAcceptAssignmentApi(orderId, { note = null } = {}, getToken) {$/
